answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 49 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. The canyon register is checked at draw time, oasis lists the eligible set, and ember seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 49 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator burns for every seat it wants. Collateral of 77 dollars is at risk. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
